Title: Blood Weakens Empty Hand Multiple Times

Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
Name: Blood Weakens
[Gehenna:R]
Cardtype: Event
Gehenna. Do not replace until a vampire commits diablerie.
Cards that (a minion plays that) require any Disciplines to play are
not replaced until the end of the current action or until any
Methuselah's hand is empty (whichever comes first). Any vampire who
commits diablerie is immune to this effect until the next Gehenna card
is played.
Artist: Jeff Holt

Blood Weakens is in play. Two vampires, R and S neither who have
diablerized since BW was played, enter combat. Vampire R has 4 Raptors
at ANI. Meth R discards down to three hand size. Vampires R and S each
play two cards requiring disciplines. Meth R has 1 card in hand and
Meth S has 5 cards in hand. Vampire R plays another card requiring
disciplines.

Who draws up to maximum hand size? Both Meth R and S or just Meth R?

Jeff

Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:


Whoops, forgot my follow on question.

The additional discipline-requiring card Vampire R played was a press
to continue combat. In round 2 of combat, Vampire R plays additional
cards requiring disciplines. Are those replaced as normal, or must
Meth R's hand be empty before redrawing those. Thanks.

Jeff

Messages.Author: RocketEddy
Messages.Body:


The answer lies in your own post: "until *any* Methuselah's hand is
empty". Thus both meths can redraw to their current hand size (7 and 3
respectively) in your example.
